elements.title: Value of Construction Sand and Gravel Produced in 2023, by State
elements.content: Map of the United States with states colored by value of construction sand and gravel produced in 2023. Color legend: <100 million dollars (light cream), 100 to 200 million dollars (light orange), >200 to 700 million dollars (orange), >700 million dollars (red). Black dots indicate sand and gravel operations. Insets show Alaska and Hawaii with similar dot markings and color coding.
elements.notes:
EXPLANATION
Value, in million dollars
• Sand and gravel operation
